six_cycle_alias.proof: Fourier modes have imaginary shifts 0 or +/-2*pi, so exponentials coincide exactly. Their modulus classes are 1, exp(-5), exp(-15), exp(-20); paired phases are +/-sqrt(3)/2, so the six eigenvalues are distinct.
six_cycle_alias.boundary: Both generators are on the same homogeneous six-cycle, have strictly positive bidirectional rates, and have different entropy production. They are outside the rigidity class.
